title: Edge history
description: Readings stored by the historian from the Sparkplug messages on the broker. Times are measurement times, so readings replayed from the gateway outbox fill outage gaps.

list.name: node
list.label: Gateway
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node FROM device_events ORDER BY 1

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM device_events WHERE device <> '' AND node IN ($node) ORDER BY 1

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM readings_1m WHERE node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) UNION SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM readings WHERE time > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Readings
panels.description: Average per interval. Up to 1 day it reads the raw readings; longer ranges read the 1-minute rollups.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), device || ' · ' || metric AS metric, avg(value) AS value
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)
  AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval), device || ' · ' || metric AS metric, sum(avg * samples) / nullif(sum(samples), 0) AS value
FROM readings_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)
  AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device, metric) time, device || ' · ' || metric AS metric, value
FROM readings
WHERE time > now() - INTERVAL '1 day' AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)
ORDER BY device, metric, time DESC

panels.title: Bad or stale readings
panels.description: Readings in the selected range whose quality is not good (device unreachable, invalid value).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "bad readings"
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND quality <> 'good'
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)

panels.title: Replayed from outbox
panels.description: Readings the gateway buffered during a broker outage and sent afterwards (Sparkplug is_historical).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS replayed
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND historical
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)

SELECT count(*) AS readings
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)

panels.title: Device online / offline
panels.description: From the Sparkplug births and deaths: DBIRTH = online; DDEATH, or the gateway's NDEATH = offline.

targets.rawSql:
WITH devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT node, device FROM device_events WHERE device <> ''
), events AS (
  SELECT time, node, device, kind, event_order FROM device_events WHERE device <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- A gateway death takes all of its devices offline.
  SELECT e.time, d.node, d.device, e.kind, e.event_order FROM device_events e JOIN devices d USING (node) WHERE e.kind = 'NDEATH'
), states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (time, node, device) time, node, device, CASE WHEN kind = 'DBIRTH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
  FROM events
  WHERE node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND time <= $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY time, node, device, event_order DESC
)
SELECT time, device AS metric, value FROM states
UNION ALL
-- Extend each last observed state to the range end, including Offline.
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, device AS metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, device) time, node, device, value
  FROM states ORDER BY node, device, time DESC
) latest
WHERE time < $__timeTo()
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Live vs replayed readings
panels.description: Readings per interval by measurement time. Replayed readings fill the period the broker was unreachable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT historical) AS live, count(*) FILTER (WHERE historical) AS replayed
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, device, metric, quality
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND quality <> 'good'
  AND node IN ($node) AND device IN ($device) AND metric IN ($metric)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 50
